rv.q: Ailey dancers truly and innately show us the music.

Although I found it less persuasive during the more lyrical moments, the work is most impressive when it draws on popular dance forms, and, like the pillars of strength they are, the company performed it magnificently.

cn.t: Critics praise Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater's return to London, with the ensemble's world-class performances and celebration of African American culture earning strong acclaim, though some works resonate more powerfully than others.
